topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following arrangements are possible in a facultative reinsurance?

I. Proportional arrangement
II. Non-proportional arrangement
III. Facultative obligatory treaty
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Under this type of reinsurance, the agreement requires reinsurance beyond the retention limit of the primary insurer. Identify.
e: Correct answer: Surplus reinsurance (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Treaty reinsurance facilitates automatic arrangement of additional surplus capacity. Comment.
o: No, this is the feature of facultative obligatory treaty
No, this is the feature of facultative reinsurance
No, this is the feature of composite reinsurance
e: Correct answer: No, this is the feature of facultative obligatory treaty (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per AS 12 Government Grants, if the government grant is received in the nature of promoter's contribution, then it should be credited to _________
e: Correct answer: Capital reserve (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Which one of the following is NOT prepared by Non profit organizations?
e: Correct answer: Profit & Loss account (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

e: Correct answer: 89.33 (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Fraud-prone areas in general insurance business include:-

I. Third Party Claim settlement
II. Off-balance sheet transaction
III. Acceptance of bad or declined risks
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: Investments in Mutual Fund/s / Venture Fund/s are valued at ____________
o: Net Asset Value (NAV) at the year-end
Average of NAV during the year
Net Asset Value (NAV) at the beginning of the year
e: Correct answer: Net Asset Value (NAV) at the year-end (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following statements is true?

I. Proportional reinsurance can assist improve combined ratio
II. Proportional reinsurance is prohibited in India
III. Non-proportional reinsurance has a potential for additional earnings
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t: As per IRDAI (General Insurance - Reinsurance) Regulations, 2000, insurers must place their reinsurance business in excess of limits defined outside India with only those reinsurers who have a rating of at least __________ with Standard & Poor or equivalent international rating agency.
e: Correct answer: BBB (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following options contains matters found in Long-Form Reports (LFAR)?

I. Cases of cheque dishonoured where the relevant risks covered have not been cancelled from inception
II. Status of large Outstanding claims-with cause-wise and year-wise analysis
III. Certification that all the dues payable to the statutory authorities have been duly paid
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
The Director's Responsibility Statement shall not contain confirmation on which of the following aspects?

I. A statement regarding an unconditional compliance with the applicable accounting standards
II. Reasons for the failure, if any, to complete the buy-back within the time specified
III. A statement that the annual accounts have been prepared on a going concern basis
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

Depreciation is charged on revalued figure of any asset with __________.

II. Prospective effect
III. Current effect
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC46 question bank).

t:
___________ investment returns are to be submitted by every insurer to the regulator.

I. Quarterly
II. Half yearly
III. Annually
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC46 question bank).

o: Debited to Profit and Loss Account
Credited to Profit and Loss Account
e: Correct answer: Credited to capital reserve (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Under the historical cost concept, which among the following cost form part of the historical cost?

I. Original purchase price
II. Cost of installation
III. Cost of transportation
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC46 question bank).

o: Profit after Tax/ No. of shares
e: Correct answer: Profit after Tax/ Net Premium (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment

e: Correct answer: Balanced portfolio (from the IC46 question bank).
